versions.changelog: New icon. The shared helper keeps its connection file private, clears update records on the last disconnect, and keeps the network route you chose when an update check fails.

Version 0.1.5

- Refined workflow to lock title and canvas before illustrations; the cover confirmation now precedes each section image confirmation.
- Updated inputs: allow body or topic as input; require use of user's title wording; clarify image ratios for cover and in-body images.
- Strengthened safeguard: do not proceed to paid image generation before locking design proposals on individual confirmation cards.
- Clarified routes: added guidance for Xiaohongshu covers and similar adjacent workflows.
- Removed unused documentation file (skill-card.md).
- Updated documentation and manifest for accuracy and clarity.
Publish the reviewed WeChat Article Visual Story workflow with its English ClawHub listing.
